decisions.refresh_request: Body is expectedVersion plus rowKey for both kinds. Extra sourceKind is strict-schema 422 ECO_REQUEST_INVALID before a transaction. Preview keeps explicit sourceKind.
decisions.refresh_kind: After the locked binding read, kind is asKind(binding.source_kind). Width 4 or 5 is checked under that kind, then only that kind's wire helper, then binding coordinates, before the kind-specific capability statement, fenceWriterEntry, admit, and provider.
decisions.get_eco: ECO get ignores req.query and keeps readStoredRow(null), which is ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 1.
decisions.get_readiness: A malformed selector, including a repeated rowKey or an extra sourceKind, is 422 ECO_REQUEST_INVALID before authorizeSheet. authorizeSheet runs before the binding-coordinate comparison. A denied sheet is 403 FORBIDDEN for a matching five-tuple and for a valid foreign five-tuple, with provider 0. An authorized reader still receives the source-configuration anchor. Record ACL none hides the selected row and leaves the anchor. Absence of a selector returns row null and canRefresh false and does not call readStoredRow.
decisions.failure_retention: Before the stale update, recheck the active actor, matched identity, and live source fingerprint. A stored selected row takes acquireRecordLinkRowAuthLockOnQuery before loadRecordPermissionScopeMap in the same transaction through the stale update. Record ACL none on that row does not stale. Readiness requires the selected tuple to be stored, so an absent second ruleset on the same binding stays active. An ECO append of a not-yet-stored eco tuple still stales the frozen collection when source, sheet, CAS, and frozen identity match. A stored ECO row still applies the optional ACL check. A later collection CAS advance or disable does not stale. 503 writes no empty row. The row-auth order is a unit query-order control.
decisions.confirm_preflight: assertExplicitTarget, inside the preflight transaction and before provider egress, uses fieldAndLock(enforce true) for a stored selected tuple and assertSourceFieldGrants for a tuple that is not stored yet. The transaction commits before HTTP. Post-HTTP publication checks remain.
decisions.runtime: After the ECO table probe, readiness runs a current_schema capability statement for four functions and two constraints. It does not use to_regclass. Failure is 503 READINESS_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE before adapter egress.
decisions.writes: The one meta_records writer arm is the exact finite ternary from kind eco to sourceCells or readinessSourceCells. The richtext guard requires that unique full helper and that full ternary.

initial_root_reds.postgresql: Root R1 selected collections and Root R3 noop/business-delta/local/comment/history/CAS passed as two separate cases. R1 comment 42P08 and R2 timestamp format were private fixture corrections. This worker did not rerun them.

static_disposition.E-S1: UNIT_REPAIRED_PROBE_NOT_RERUN. Shape 422 before authorizeSheet. Coordinate 409 after authorizeSheet. Denied sheet matching and valid foreign tuple are 403 with provider 0. Sheet-authorized readers still receive the source-configuration anchor.
static_disposition.E-S2: UNIT_QUERY_ORDER_ONLY. acquireRecordLinkRowAuthLockOnQuery precedes loadRecordPermissionScopeMap for a stored selected row and stays in that transaction through the stale update. Source lock still precedes the binding lock. This is not a PostgreSQL interleaving proof.
static_disposition.E-S3: UNIT_REPAIRED_ECO_PROBE_NOT_RUN. A not-yet-stored ECO tuple on token 401 still stales the frozen collection. An absent readiness ruleset on the same binding stays active. Two rulesets in one readiness binding are one binding.
static_disposition.E-S4: UNIT_REPAIRED_NOT_PG. Preflight fieldAndLock or assertSourceFieldGrants runs before provider egress. Granted business-delta confirm is provider 1 with a meta_records update. Selected-row none, readiness read-only, hidden, concealed, and new-tuple read-only are provider 0.
static_disposition.richtext_false_green: CLOSED_IN_CURRENT_VALIDATOR. Full unique readinessSourceCells helper and exact full ternary. Local cell before the loop and review_note in the readiness arm invalidate SAFE. The frozen old /tmp validator was not rerun and is not the green proof.
